subject: Security intake: EmpowerHealth SIG playbook kickoff
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@empowerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: EmpowerHealth SIG playbook kickoff

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can get the SIG/CAIQ path moving: 

Call highlights (from our side)
- EmpowerHealth is evaluating Redwood for chat/embeddings across patient-facing workflows.
- Primary compliance asks: BAA requirement for PHI, SOC 2 status, GDPR residency for EU patients, and a vendor questionnaire the security team runs.
- You prefer a single vendor playbook approach (prefill CAIQ/SIG vs custom form).

Immediate asks / action items
1) Can you confirm whether your evaluation will include production systems that store PHI? (Yes/no) — this determines whether we need a BAA immediately. (Liam)
2) Please tell us the SOC 2 status and expected audit date (Type I/II and target quarter). (Liam)
3) Which questionnaire format do you want us to start with: (A) standard SIG/CAIQ prefill we provide, or (B) your custom portal form? If (A), we'll prefill our CAIQ and attach. If (B), please share a link + expected owner. (Security team)
4) Any strict data residency requirements (e.g., EU-only hosting) beyond the call notes? (Liam)

Proposed timeline
- Today: I’ll send a prefill template and a short MAP (mutual action plan).
- EOD Thu (2026-09-17): we aim to have your answers + any initial evidence or portal links so our security ops can start bundling artifacts.

I've CC'ed Ben (sales engineering) and Marissa (security ops lead) to coordinate evidence collection and to scope whether a CAIQ or custom questionnaire is the efficient route.

Attachment: I will be sending a lightweight prefill workbook (empower_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx) — you can edit directly and return.

Thanks — Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@empowerhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: EmpowerHealth Security <security@empowerhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 18:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake: EmpowerHealth SIG playbook kickoff

Thanks Stephanie — quick answers inline and attached a partially completed sheet.

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 3:02 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Can you confirm whether your evaluation will include production systems that store PHI?

Yes — the pilot will ingest and store PHI from our triage flow. We require a BAA before going live.

> Please tell us the SOC 2 status and expected audit date (Type I/II and target quarter).

We are engaged with an audit firm and expect SOC 2 Type I by end of Q4 2026; Type II targeted Q3 2027.

> Which questionnaire format do you want us to start with: CAIQ prefill or your custom portal?

We can accept a CAIQ prefill to speed review, but our security team will also re-run answers in our vendor portal (we sync results). I attached the portal invite link and a partially filled prefill.

> Data residency requirements?

Primary residency is US-only for PHI; EU residency applies for EU patient data but this pilot will be US-only.

Attachment: empower_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains answers to ~40% of the CAIQ.

Availability: I’m out Wed morning but can hop on a 30-min clarifying call Thu 2026-09-17 10:00–11:30 PT if that works.

— Liam
Director, Platform Security
EmpowerHealth
liam.oconnell@empowerhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@empowerhealth.com>, EmpowerHealth Security <security@empowerhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: EmpowerHealth SIG playbook kickoff

Thanks Liam — great context and clear path. Two quick clarifications from our side so the MAP is actionable:

1) BAA: noted as required. Marissa, can you draft a standard BAA and share with EmpowerHealth legal? We will also add a placeholder to the MAP for "BAA signed" as a gating item before production.

2) SOC 2 timing: Q4 Type I is workable. Marissa, please list the evidence we’ll need in the first pass (control descriptions, architecture diagram, encryption key management, incident response playbook).

3) CAIQ vs portal: since Liam can accept CAIQ prefill, we’ll complete the CAIQ based on the attached sheet and upload to your portal as an FYI. Liam — do you have an owner that will look for evidence uploads, or should we send things to security@empowerhealth.com?

4) PHI scope: because pilot includes PHI storage, we will treat this as production-side onboarding for evidence. Marissa to drive evidence bundling with a two-week sprint.

Proposed next steps and owners
- EOD Wed (09/16): Redwood completes CAIQ prefill draft. (Ben + Stephanie)
- Thu 09/17 10:00 PT: 30-min clarifying call to confirm BAA flow and portal upload steps. (All)
- Tue 09/22: Security ops opens evidence bundle and confirms any missing artifacts. (Marissa)

If that timeline looks good Liam, I’ll publish the MAP and send calendar invites.

—Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0034

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@empowerhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: EmpowerHealth SIG playbook kickoff

All good — the proposed timeline works. A couple final notes before the call:

- Our portal owner is the security inbox (security@empowerhealth.com). Uploads to the portal should be accompanied by a short manifest. We’ll accept CAIQ prefill followed by portal verification.
- BAA: legal will need the draft; please add our legal contact (diana.liu@empowerhealth.com) when sharing.
- Encryption/KMS: we use AWS KMS (customer-managed CMKs for production). Please mark key management and KMS rotation policy as high priority.
- Evidence access: we’ll prefer links to a shared drive over in-line attachments where possible.

I’ll join Thu 09/17 at 10:00 PT. See you then.

— Liam

Attachments referenced: empower_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx
Portal link: https://vendor.empowerhealth.com/onboard/portal/ABCD-Invite
Signed BAA route (for tracking): https://docusign.com/empowerhealth/BAA/12345
